The libsamplerate submodule uses the upstream revision 0844c208f683527c08ea8a80acc13b398aa9c8bf (0.2.2). The parent build verifies the audio source files against SHA256SUMS and enables the fastest sinc converter in the static library. The audio core includes queued SRC input in its drift estimate. Recheck fractional backlog, impulse response and rate-drift tests when updating the dependency.
